import inspect
from solution import get_Odd_Occurrence


def test_issue_example_from_issue():
    """Example get_Odd_Occurrence([1,2,3,1,2,3,1],7) == 1."""
    # counts: 1->3 (3 % 2 == 1), 2->2 (2 % 2 == 0), 3->2 (2 % 2 == 0)
    assert get_Odd_Occurrence([1, 2, 3, 1, 2, 3, 1], 7) == 1


def test_issue_single_element():
    """Find the element occurring odd number of times for a single element."""
    # count: 5->1 (1 % 2 == 1)
    assert get_Odd_Occurrence([5], 1) == 5


def test_issue_odd_at_end():
    """Find the element occurring odd number of times when it is at the end."""
    # counts: 2->2 (2 % 2 == 0), 3->1 (1 % 2 == 1)
    assert get_Odd_Occurrence([2, 2, 3], 3) == 3


def test_issue_odd_at_start():
    """Find the element occurring odd number of times when it is at the start."""
    # counts: 4->1 (1 % 2 == 1), 5->2 (2 % 2 == 0)
    assert get_Odd_Occurrence([4, 5, 5], 3) == 4


def test_issue_triple_in_middle():
    """Find the element occurring odd number of times with count three."""
    # counts: 2->2 (2 % 2 == 0), 3->3 (3 % 2 == 1)
    assert get_Odd_Occurrence([2, 3, 3, 3, 2], 5) == 3


def test_issue_five_occurrences():
    """Find the element occurring odd number of times with count five."""
    # counts: 1->5 (5 % 2 == 1), 2->4 (4 % 2 == 0)
    assert get_Odd_Occurrence([1, 2, 1, 2, 1, 2, 1, 2, 1], 9) == 1


def test_issue_negative_numbers():
    """Find the element occurring odd number of times with negative values."""
    # counts: -1->1 (1 % 2 == 1), -2->2 (2 % 2 == 0)
    assert get_Odd_Occurrence([-1, -2, -2], 3) == -1


def test_issue_zero_odd():
    """Find the element occurring odd number of times when it is zero."""
    # count: 0->3 (3 % 2 == 1)
    assert get_Odd_Occurrence([0, 0, 0], 3) == 0


def test_issue_large_values():
    """Find the element occurring odd number of times with large values."""
    # counts: 1000000->2 (2 % 2 == 0), 999999->1 (1 % 2 == 1)
    assert get_Odd_Occurrence([1000000, 999999, 1000000], 3) == 999999


def test_contract_importable_callable():
    """Implement get_Odd_Occurrence(arr, arr_size) in solution.py."""
    # check: 1 == 1 callable object expected
    assert callable(get_Odd_Occurrence)


def test_contract_takes_two_args():
    """Signature must be get_Odd_Occurrence(arr, arr_size) with two parameters."""
    # check: 1 + 1 == 2 parameters expected
    assert len(inspect.signature(get_Odd_Occurrence).parameters) == 2
